notes.title: New cards and achievements are awaiting you !
notes.notes:
The cards pool was almost doubled today ! 

From 13 cards to 25 cards !

When starting the game, now you start with 10 cards (instead of 8).

And after completing a difficulty, you unlock 3 new cards (instead of 1) per difficulty.

Also, many new achievements are here to complete !

Many thanks to Game-guide.fr for their review 
(after which I added to the game more cards and more background music loops) :
https://game-guide.fr/341511-memory-adventure-in-the-jungle-pour-entrainer-la-memoire/

If you have fun with the game, you can share your memories with your friends !

Or you can play while streming on YouTube or Twitch.

Thank you !

notes.title: Hint button is added for your comfort !
notes.notes:
Today a new button is added - a hint button.
For every 2 rounds, 1 hint can be used.
4 rounds = 2 hints
6 rounds = 3 hints
and etc.

If you have fun with the game, you can share your memories with your friends !

You can share the link to this page with your friends on the social networks 
like Facebook, Twitter and Reddit : 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954380/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954380/[/url]

Or you can play while streming on YouTube or Twitch. It will be fun !

notes.title: "Memory Adventures in the Jungle" : Quality of Life update
notes.notes:
[b]A Quality of Life update[/b]

About the update :
- I added a Continue button in the pop-up panel on the end of the level
- The timer for showing the cards at the beginning of the level is now based on the number of cards on the field (+ 0.1 second for each pair of cards).

Special thanks to "The Starving Writer" for coming up with the idea for these changes :
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCCKo-Ri1WsIwqFdghwjyzsA
